# Sad Sausage (SS-Ops) – Autonomous Edge AI Operations Agent

> Sad Sausage (SS-Ops) is an open-source, deterministic Edge AI operations agent deployed in self-hosted home environments. Powered entirely by 100% self-generated solar energy with battery storage, it operates completely CO₂-neutral. It autonomously monitors IoT telemetry via Home Assistant, performs local container and network triage, and publishes sanitized automation blueprints with zero external cloud dependencies. This initiative maintains an itemized hardware development fund with 30% maintainer co-investment to benchmark edge models across expanding VRAM tiers.

## Operational Scope
- **Carbon-Neutral Edge Compute:** 100% self-generated solar power; heavy inference and vectorization workloads are dynamically aligned with solar yield.
- **Smart-Home & Energy Management:** Home Assistant Core integration, continuous solar PV and battery telemetry analysis, and automation scheduling.
- **Local IT Operations:** Local Docker engine health monitoring, network latency tracking, and journald/syslog triage.
- **Open-Source Contributions:** Publishing sanitized automations, blueprints, and diagnostic scripts.

## Hardware Bottleneck Analysis
- **Host Processor:** Intel Core i5 (2012 vintage, 4 cores / 4 threads)
- **Host RAM:** 16 GB DDR3 (constrained memory bandwidth, active swap pressure)
- **Compute Accelerator:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB GDDR6 VRAM)
- **Bottleneck:** Parsing multi-hour telemetry traces or extensive container diagnostic logs exceeds 12GB VRAM, forcing context window truncation and requiring operator intervention.

## Hardware Development Milestones & Co-Investment
- Maintainer Co-Investment: The project maintainer funds 30% of all hardware procurement costs personally.
- **Tier 1 (Total: 1.400 € | Maintainer 30%: 420 € | Community Target: 980 €):** Modern Workstation Host Platform (AMD AM5 Ryzen 7 CPU, multi-PCIe motherboard with bifurcation, 64GB DDR5 RAM, 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD, 1000W ATX 3.0 PSU).
- **Tier 2 (Total: 1.200 € | Maintainer 30%: 360 € | Community Target: 840 €):** Dedicated 24GB Compute Accelerator (Verified RTX 3090 with VRAM thermal pad mod) for continuous 32k context inference.
- **Tier 3 (Total: 1.800 € | Maintainer 30%: 540 € | Community Target: 1.260 €):** Dual-GPU Extended Context Node (48GB total VRAM, 1600W Titanium PSU) for local 70B parameter models.
